name: Octolens
description: Octolens is an AI-powered social listening platform that monitors brand, competitor, and market mentions across social media, developer communities, news, podcasts, and other online sources. It filters mentions by relevance, sentiment, and intent, then delivers actionable alerts through APIs, webhooks, Slack, and email.

events.d: Find mentions filtered by source, sentiment, keywords, date range, or relevance; select fields and include metrics.
Create a keyword to monitor mentions and configure platforms, tag, matching, exclusions, and alerts.
Modify an existing keyword monitor to change tracked terms, platforms, filters (relevance, sentiment, intent), or alert settings.
Permanently delete a keyword monitor using its keyword ID.
Returns all saved feeds from your Octolens workspace.
Modify an existing feed's settings, filters, or query parameters.
Get information about a specific organization tracked by Octolens.
List keywords currently tracked. Optionally select which response fields to return.
